implied_probability_calibration.method: home-team perspective (neutral sites: alphabetically first team; FBS-at-FCS: the FBS team); non-disputed closing spreads; completed, non-tied games; each game counted once

methodology.cover_margin: team score minus opponent score plus team closing spread (positive = covered)
methodology.implied_probability: Approximate win probability derived from the closing point spread with the existing logistic conversion (scale 19.5 points, fitted on 7,560 FBS games 2016-2025). Spreads are quoted at roughly equal prices on both sides; no moneyline prices or bookmaker margin (vig/fees) are used, so this is not a traded price, an executable quote or a share of bets or money.
limitations: Descriptive records are not predictions or future-win probabilities
Opening-line movement is not published: CFBD permission covers closing lines only
Disputed games are excluded from primary figures; ATS including disputed games is shown separately
Published teams are current FBS programs; games against FCS opponents count for the FBS team
methodology.market_expectation: sum of spread-implied win probabilities compared with actual wins; descriptive only
methodology.primary_population: games with the selected provider's non-disputed closing value and a final score
methodology.rates: pushes excluded from the denominator; Wilson 95% interval
methodology.total_margin: combined points minus closing total (positive = over)

caveats: The closing line is observed at kickoff, after the forecast was recorded; the two are not simultaneous.
Differences describe disagreement only. They are not edges, picks or evidence that either source is better; accuracy comparison on identical games is reserved for the Milestone 6 validation.

excluded_reasons.game_not_in_archive: the game has not been played yet or had no closing line in the archive
excluded_reasons.non_fbs_matchup: neither team is a current FBS program, so no licensed closing line exists
excluded_reasons.not_generated_before_kickoff: carried-forward entry without a pre-kickoff generation record
excluded_reasons.spread_disputed: providers disagreed by 3 or more points; excluded from the primary comparison

model_total.reason: The incumbent model does not produce game totals, so no model-vs-market totals comparison is made.

model_vs_market.population: authentic pregame forecasts (generated and recorded before kickoff by an identified model) joined by game ID to the selected provider's non-disputed closing spread

retrospective_replays.reason: No model forecasts were archived before kickoff for 2016-2025. Retrospective replays (for example the V6 research challenger) are calculations made after the games and are neither used here nor presented as pregame predictions.

multiple_comparisons.note: With many teams, about 5% of 95% intervals exclude 50% by chance alone; an excluded interval is not proof of a lasting trend.
